clue.text: Abundant promises by policewoman

parts.note: a cop is any police officer, here a woman one
IOUs are written promises to pay

explanation.surface: A female officer makes plenty of pledges.
explanation.definitionFit: Copious is a synonym of plentiful, existing in large quantities.

clue.text: Search volunteers coming back into battle

parts.note: to comb an area is to search it thoroughly

indicators.note: coming back tells us the volunteers' letters are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force

explanation.surface: A search party of volunteers returns to the fighting.
explanation.walkthrough: TA, the Territorial Army, is Britain's part-time volunteer reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: Combat is a synonym of fighting or a fight between forces.

clue.text: Oat chips spread over single nut

indicators.note: spread suggests the letters of the snack words are scattered and laid out afresh

parts.note: single means one, the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A snack of oat chips with a lone nut on top.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spread' mixes the letters of OATCHIPS together with I, and 'over' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: The pistachio is a green-kernelled edible nut, an example of the class.

clue.text: Held up in hag-ridden woods

indicators.note: up in a down clue says the concealed letters read from bottom to top
in shows the letters sit inside the run of words hag-ridden woods

explanation.surface: Something is stuck in woods haunted by a witch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' finds DENWO inside 'hag-ridden woods', and 'up' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: To have owned something is to have held or possessed it.

clue.text: What was lost in Freudian Era?

parts.note: a Freudian is a psychoanalyst, slangily a shrink
an era is an age

explanation.surface: A question about what vanished during Freud's period.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface invites a history of psychoanalysis; 'Freudian' is slang for a psychiatrist instead.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrinkage is the amount by which something has diminished, the loss incurred.

clue.text: A satellite missing initial controller

indicators.note: missing initial tells us the satellite word loses its opening letter

parts.note: an orbiter is a craft circling a planet, a satellite

explanation.surface: A satellite has lost its first controller.
explanation.definitionFit: An arbiter is a judge who has the final say, one who controls a dispute.

clue.text: Upwardly mobile secretary concealed bug

indicators.note: upwardly mobile in a down clue means the secretary's letters climb, reading bottom to top

parts.note: a PA is a personal assistant, a secretary
to have concealed something is to have hid it

explanation.surface: An ambitious secretary hid a listening device.
explanation.definitionFit: An aphid is a small sap-sucking insect, one example of a bug.

clue.text: Intoxicated snake found in drained radiator

indicators.note: found in shows the snake is placed within the other piece

parts.note: a radiator that has been drained of air has been bled
the adder is a venomous snake

explanation.surface: A snake turns up while someone bleeds a radiator, and a drunk is involved.
explanation.walkthrough: BLADDERED is British slang for very drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Bladdered is informal British slang for heavily drunk.

clue.text: Rates poorly assembled weapon

indicators.note: poorly assembled says the letters of rates are put together in a botched order

explanation.surface: A judgement that a weapon has been badly built.
explanation.definitionFit: A Taser is a stun gun firing electrified darts, one kind of weapon.

clue.text: Whistle blower conceals perjury and reveals rest

indicators.note: conceals shows the official's letters wrap round the falsehood

parts.note: a referee, or ref, blows the whistle in football
perjury is telling a lie under oath

explanation.surface: A whistleblower hides false testimony then exposes it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Whistle blower' looks like an informant, but it is the referee.
explanation.definitionFit: Relief is a break or respite, as in relief from duty.

clue.text: Building manors without right craftsman

indicators.note: building suggests the remaining letters are constructed into a new word
without means the right letter is dropped from manors

explanation.surface: Building country houses without a proper craftsman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes R to leave MANOS, which 'Building' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A mason is a skilled worker in stone, a type of craftsman.

clue.text: Listen to soprano during physical exercise

indicators.note: during puts the listening and soprano letters within the physical word

parts.note: physical things are real, tangible
to listen to is to hear
S is the abbreviation for soprano in music

explanation.surface: Hearing a singer during a workout.
explanation.definitionFit: A rehearsal is a practice run, an exercise performed before the real thing.

clue.text: Left a party held in illicit surroundings

indicators.note: held in shows the party is contained within the illicit word
surroundings confirms the illicit word forms the outer layer

parts.note: something illicit is banned
a do is a party

explanation.surface: Someone departed a party staged in a shady venue.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave something behind permanently is to have abandoned it; deserted is a synonym.

clue.text: Lament backing electronic network

indicators.note: backing means the pair of pieces is read in reverse order

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for electronic, as in e-mail
a grid is a network, as of power lines

explanation.surface: Mourning the support for an electronic network.
explanation.definitionFit: A dirge is a mournful song for the dead, a lament.

clue.text: In this way ruffian's not good

indicators.note: not tells us to drop the good letter from the ruffian word

parts.note: a ruffian is a thug, and with the possessive gives thug's

explanation.surface: A remark that this is why the ruffian is a bad lot.
explanation.definitionFit: Thus is a formal adverb meaning so, or like this.

clue.text: Replace great tennis star on the radio

indicators.note: on the radio means we hear the phrase spoken rather than written

parts.note: super means great or excellent; a seed is a top tennis player ranked in the draw

explanation.surface: A broadcaster swaps in a top tennis player.
explanation.definitionFit: To supersede is to take the place of something older, a synonym of replace.

clue.text: When class education is mixed

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
a class is a sort or kind

explanation.surface: A question about when a school class becomes co-educational.
explanation.definitionFit: Assorted means of various kinds put together, a synonym of varied.

clue.text: Abrasive way fish court lovers at first

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way
an eel is a snake-like fish
to court someone is to woo them

indicators.note: at first takes only the opening letter of lovers

explanation.surface: An abrasive manner by which a fish courts lovers.
explanation.definitionFit: Steel wool is a pad of fine steel threads used to scour and polish, an abrasive material.

clue.text: Dispose of deranged acid eater

indicators.note: deranged means put out of order, so the letters of acid eater are rearranged

explanation.surface: Get rid of a mad person who consumes acid.
explanation.definitionFit: To eradicate is to wipe out entirely, a synonym of get rid of.

clue.text: Vie to hold left end

indicators.note: to hold means the vying word grips the left letter inside it

parts.note: to vie is to compete

explanation.surface: Struggling to keep hold of the left-hand end.
explanation.definitionFit: To complete a task is to finish or end it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Lack of uneven elements in admirable face

indicators.note: with the odd-numbered letters of admirable gone, only its even-numbered ones are kept

explanation.surface: An admirable face that lacks anything irregular.
explanation.definitionFit: A dial is the face of a clock or watch.

clue.text: Youngster accepting help to get debt-free

indicators.note: accepting shows the youngster's letters take in the help

parts.note: a pup is a young dog, or a cheeky youngster
aid means help

explanation.surface: A young person takes assistance to clear their debts.
explanation.definitionFit: Paid-up describes someone whose dues are fully settled, so owing nothing.

clue.text: Highlight son's hair

parts.note: a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: Putting highlights in a boy's hair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Highlight' is a verb here, not the hairdresser's streaks.
explanation.definitionFit: To stress something is to emphasise or draw attention to it.

clue.text: Provoke fisherman to ditch line

indicators.note: to ditch means the fisherman discards the line letter

parts.note: an angler fishes with rod and line

explanation.surface: Annoying a fisherman by making him throw away his line.
explanation.definitionFit: To anger someone is to enrage or rile them, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Wind tiny bit of orange zest

parts.note: a gust is a sudden blast of wind

indicators.note: tiny bit of takes just the opening letter of orange

explanation.surface: Wind carries off a fragment of orange peel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'zest' looks like peel beside 'orange'; it is the definition, meaning enthusiasm.
explanation.definitionFit: Gusto is hearty enjoyment or relish, a synonym of enthusiasm.

clue.text: Globe feature writer

parts.note: a globe is a ball
a point is a feature, as in 'a selling point'

explanation.surface: A distinguishing mark of a world-famous author.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballpoint is a pen, something one writes with.

clue.text: Two notes sounding small and bright

indicators.note: sounding tells us to say the letter names out loud

parts.note: B and D are both musical notes

explanation.surface: Two musical notes ring out small and clear.
explanation.definitionFit: Beady eyes are small, round and glinting.

clue.text: Escapes tower clutching sauce

indicators.note: clutching shows the phrase escapes tower holds the letters in its grasp

explanation.surface: Someone breaks out of a tower holding a sauce.
explanation.definitionFit: Pesto is a basil, garlic and pine-nut sauce for pasta.

clue.text: Posse dread losing single second breaking outlaw

indicators.note: breaking says the remaining letters are smashed and reassembled
losing means one letter is dropped from posse dread

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for second, and only one of the two in posse goes

explanation.surface: The posse fears losing a second while they break the outlaw.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing' drops one S from POSSEDREAD; 'breaking' rearranges the nine letters left.
explanation.definitionFit: A desperado is a reckless, violent criminal, especially in the Wild West.

clue.text: Counterfeit drug causes disappointment

parts.note: a sham is a fake, something counterfeit
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Fake drugs leave a buyer let down.
explanation.definitionFit: A shame is a pity, something regrettable, as in 'what a shame'.

clue.text: Astronomer found in shabby motel in Paraguay

indicators.note: in puts the shuffled motel inside the country's code

parts.note: PY is the international code for Paraguay

indicators.note: shabby suggests the motel is knocked about, its letters disordered

explanation.surface: A stargazer turns up in a run-down South American motel.
explanation.definitionFit: Ptolemy was the Alexandrian astronomer who proposed an earth-centred universe.

clue.text: Criminals — they're regularly found in toilets

indicators.note: found in shows those picked letters sit inside the toilets word

parts.note: loos are toilets

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of they're

explanation.surface: Crooks keep turning up in the lavatories.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the odd letters of 'they're', ignoring the apostrophe.
explanation.definitionFit: Looters are people who steal during disorder, a kind of criminal.
